LanguageData.LP_ElderBrain.label: elder brain
LanguageData.LP_ElderBrain.description:
A huge brain floating in psionic brine, the mental core of a mind flayer colony. After building it, place a mind flayer corpse next to it to awaken it.

Every humanlike brain devoured by the colony's mind flayers on the same map flows into the elder brain: at 1/4/10/20/35 brains in total it reaches levels 1-5. The elder brain periodically produces mind flayer tadpoles (one every 5 days at level 1, one per day at level 5) and keeps the "inherited memories" of the last 5 victims, which can be bottled into brine jars to let a mind flayer inherit 80% of their XP.

The elder brain must be fed with herbal medicine or food (raw meat, meals); without food it stops producing and loses one memory for each day it starves. When the elder brain is destroyed, all mind flayers are badly hurt.
LanguageData.LP_BrainJar.label: brine jar
LanguageData.LP_BrainJar.description: A jar of psionic brine drawn from an elder brain, sealing the memories of one devoured victim. A mind flayer who uses it inherits 80% of its skill XP.
